Latin word

paulum

paulum, paulī n.

noun, second declension, with a genitive (paulum silvae); with verbs, an adverb · Declension on Wiktionary

a little; slightly, a little (with verbs and prepositions)

In this lexicon

  • a little

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 340

  • slightly

    the recommended word · classical · Caes. BG 6.9: paulum suprā eum locum (Lewis & Short); Cic. Agr. 2.85: paulum differre (Lewis & Short)
